selectionCriteria: Five complete scenes per film franchise, including existing clips; distinct continuous excerpts, at least two speakers, and several dialogue turns. TV and First English collections remain unchanged.
verification: Rendered cuts checked against platform captions and independent base.en speech recognition, with utterance-constrained CTC word timing and visually inspected character crops. This records authoring review, not a full human linguistic or age-rating review.
